races.name: Sky Bet Extra Places Handicap

runners_data.name: Coincidental Glory
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong Dundalk form but needs to prove turf effectiveness, well-positioned for any pace scenario
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown his best form at Dundalk and needs to improve on this season's turf form; best placing on turf was in a 1m claimer at Gowran; big price when in rear over 7f here 11 days ago.

runners_data.name: Wild Berries
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with 258-day absence creates significant fitness concerns despite useful form when fresh
runners_data.spotlight: Best of her three efforts in maidens was over 7f at Naas; well beaten over 1m in a nursery at the same venue; no recent outing; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Caitouna
runners_data.note: Only confirmed leader with 7lb claim advantage, key pace-setter but stamina questions over 6½f
runners_data.comment: Two Dundalk displays have been respectable, will need to find more to win a turf maiden
runners_data.spotlight: Two respectable Dundalk runs; fair effort at Leopardstown on turf debut; useful 7lb claimed; not without a chance.

runners_data.name: Amerilis
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits the likely pace, good recent fourth here shows effectiveness on track
runners_data.comment: Two runs for Paddy Twomey, made a good start for Gillian Scott here in March, interesting
runners_data.spotlight: Ran twice for Paddy Twomey at two; made a good start for Gillian Scott when fourth of 12 in a 6f maiden here  in March, running on well in the closing stages; not beaten far in mid-field here on handicap debut; could go well at a decent price.

runners_data.name: Dubai Opulence
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with concerning fading tendency and modest form level makes winning unlikely
runners_data.comment: Hasn't counted in either m'den run; gelded since and hooded now but much more required
runners_data.spotlight: Modest form in three maiden runs on soft or heavy ground; hard to make a case for him.

runners_data.name: Whats It All About
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with fade warnings and weak form provides little appeal in this company
runners_data.comment: Nothing in 2yo maidens; can only be watched on seasonal debut in first handicap
runners_data.spotlight: Weak juvenile maiden form; failed to feature over 5f at Dundalk in her first handicap; needs to show some spark before becoming a betting proposition.

runners_data.name: Meriden
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with excellent recent 7f win, likely to benefit most from expected sustainable pace
runners_data.comment: Got going late when sixth of 13 on handicap debut at Ballinrobe (9.5f); others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Never threatened in three maidens at 6f-1m on soft/AW; got going late when sixth of 13 on handicap debut over an extended 1m1f; a great deal better when winning over 7f at Down Royal last Friday; an improving filly but may find a few too good over this trip under a 7lb penalty

runners_data.name: Cisterna
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner from in-form Slattery yard, recent 7f+ wins suggest stamina edge over pure speed
runners_data.spotlight: Uneven form last season; has improved gradually this season; stayed well over an extended 7f to open his account at Roscommon; possibly vulnerable over this trip off 5lb higher mark.

runners_data.name: Aurora Mist
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with 1m win but second-string from stable that also runs recent winner Cisterna
runners_data.spotlight: Obtained plenty of experience at two; won over 1m at Gowran on second start this season; stable may have a stronger candidate in another last-time-out winner Cisterna

runners_data.name: Gonna Be Golden
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with fitness questions after 6-day turnaround from poor seasonal debut effort
runners_data.comment: AW maiden winner, bombed out on soft on h'cap debut (1m), could improve for better ground
runners_data.spotlight: One of two for yard; Dundalk maiden winner last December (7f); heavy ground probably against him when tailed off on seasonal/handicap debut over 1m at this venue; saddle slipped early in 6f Fairyhouse contest last week; the run can be ignored

runners_data.name: Apothic Red
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who showed promise on handicap debut here, each-way appeal at likely odds
runners_data.spotlight: Ignored in the betting on handicap debut in a 6f event here in April; kept on to finish sixth of 21, showing enough to suggest an each-way chance now.

runners_data.name: Schoolyard Days
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with weak form and cheekpieces addition fails to inspire confidence
runners_data.spotlight: Weak maiden form at sprint trips; failed to improve when raised on distance and equipped with cheekpieces in a claimer at Roscommon.

runners_data.name: Pocket Jacks
runners_data.note: Uncertain style with potential 5f pace that could suit if race becomes sprint finish
runners_data.spotlight: Midfield in a pair of Dundalk maidens (6f/7f) at two;  hinted at possible improvement over 5f on reappearance at Navan; may slot into handicaps effectively.

runners_data.name: Kilmac Air
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with fair form level, cheekpieces and 5lb claim provide tactical advantages
runners_data.comment: Recent fourth here (6f) a step in the right direction but a lot more likely required here
runners_data.spotlight: Has made the frame twice at Cork; opening mark seems fair and she may improve on better ground with cheekpieces fitted; 5lb claim will help too.

runners_data.name: Boston Max
runners_data.note: Prominent with fade concerns but recent 5f wins show speed, gelding operation brought improvement
runners_data.comment: Big improvement when scoring (5f, AW; first-time tongue-tie) on handicap debut; key player
runners_data.spotlight: Three undistinguished runs on turf last season; different proposition this term since being gelded; won over 5f at Dundalk on AW/ handicap/seasonal debut in first-time tongue-tie; got up late to share the honours over the same trip at Chepstow 13 days ago; may find further improvement at this distance.

runners_data.name: Enthusiastically
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid Dundalk form but 82-day break creates fitness questions
runners_data.comment: Improved when switched to AW by Donnacha O'Brien last year, fair chance on yard debut
runners_data.spotlight: Won a 7f Dundalk nursery win on AW debut last November; confirmed a fair standard of form with two fourth placings later that month; formerly trained by Donnacha O'Brien; did not quite see out the 1m trip when making a satisfactory debut for Sean Hayes at Dundalk in March; one for the shortlist.

runners_data.name: Dawn Flame
runners_data.note: Prominent with fade warnings, January Dundalk win appears isolated form peak
runners_data.comment: Failed to see out a longer trip here last time, better judged on C&D win in January
runners_data.spotlight: Dundalk win in January (1m) seems to have been a flash in the pan; started his career with two poor runs on turf.

runners_data.name: Gosford Queen
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with 173-day absence makes fitness highly questionable despite improvement potential
runners_data.comment: Ran promising enough race on second start over C&D; could be an improver on h'cap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Not a bad effort when fifth of nine over 5f at Dundalk on the second of three starts as a juvenile; open to improvement, but others have stronger credentials.

runners_data.name: Whistling Jamesie
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with fade tendency, blinkers addition suggests connections seeking spark
runners_data.comment: Won at 20-1 on handicap debut over 6f at Dundalk; down the field over 7f at same course
runners_data.spotlight: Won at 20-1 on handicap debut over 6f at Dundalk last October; in rear over 7f at the same course in April; last of 12 at Naas; blinkers tried now; seems risky.

runners_data.name: Windsor Lily
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with modest form level and fade warnings provide limited winning chances
runners_data.comment: Best run over 6f in Dundalk maiden, no impact over 7f on h'cap debut, a bit to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Not beaten fair in fifth in a 6f Dundalk maiden in February; no impact over 7f on soft at Gowran in her first handicap, her chance is not obvious.

runners_data.name: Polanco
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with no winning potential shown and consistent poor form across all distances
runners_data.comment: No show in maidens at 7f-7.5f, gelded, watch on handicap debut and seasonal return
runners_data.spotlight: No sign of winning potential in maidens last year; 50-1, in rear at Naas on handicap debut.

races.paceDynamic: Caitouna is the only confirmed front-runner in this 21-runner handicap and will likely dictate terms from the rail without pressure. The prominent runners Coincidental Glory, Amerilis, Kilmac Air, Boston Max, Enthusiastically and Dawn Flame will track behind but none are aggressive pace-pressers. This creates a sustainable gallop over 6½f that will suit horses who can finish strongly from off the pace. The lack of early speed pressure heavily favours hold-up horses and patient rides, as the pace will be manageable and allow closers to unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Caitouna leads uncontested with moderate fractions through halfway
scenarios.body: The pace becomes very manageable allowing hold-up horses to close strongly in the final 2f as the early leaders tire. Patient rides on improving handicappers with finishing speed dominate the finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Control
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack of Coincidental Glory and Boston Max apply more pressure than expected
scenarios.body: The pace quickens enough to compromise pure hold-up horses but still allows those tracking in 4th-8th to strike. Horses positioned just behind the leaders get first run on the tiring pace-setters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Caitouna gets completely uncontested fractions and finds extra stamina
scenarios.body: The soft pace allows the leader to kick clear in the final furlong before closers can mount their challenges. Early positioning proves decisive over finishing speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the gallop becomes crawling slow with multiple horses still in contention turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from 2f out heavily favouring the best raw speed regardless of position. Horses with proven 5f pace dominate over stamina types.

watchPoints.text: Caitouna's fractions through the first 3f will determine whether hold-up horses get their ideal setup or face too much ground to make up
Boston Max's early positioning given his tendency to fade - if prominent early his recent 5f form may not translate to 6½f
The gap between Caitouna and the first prominent trackers after 2f will indicate whether the pace pressure materializes
Meriden and Aurora Mist from the Hogan/Slattery yards respectively need patient rides to maximize their closing kicks in this large field
Any significant early pace pressure from Coincidental Glory or Enthusiastically would completely change the tactical complexion

races.name: TRI Equestrian Maiden

runners_data.name: The Piper's Call
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with proven class edge, returns after 333 days but has winning form on similar going
runners_data.comment: Two good runs last summer at 6f on good ground; upped in trip on seasonal return
runners_data.spotlight: Decent level of form in two runs last summer at 6f (both on good); second of 13 behind subsequent Group 3 runner-up Flushing Meadows at this venue; not quite as good but respectable nonetheless when third at Naas; gelded since.

runners_data.name: Forbidden
runners_data.note: Debutant with strong pedigree connections to Group-level performers, completely unknown quantity first time
runners_data.spotlight: Third foal; dam 6f winner (RPR 69), half-sister to useful 7f/1m winner Selinka (dam of 5f Group 3 winner Hit The Bid), out of 6f Listed winner; best watched on belated debut at four

runners_data.name: Ask Me Again
runners_data.note: Well-bred newcomer who failed to sell for substantial sum, holds up and trainer struggling for winners
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to sell for E240,000 as a yearling; eighth foal; closely related to US Grade 3 turf winner Queen Picasso; half-brother to four winners including Aclaim (6f-1m inc 2yo/AW/Group 1; 118) and Aimeric (Listed-placed 11.6f-1m5f; 114); dam 7f winner.

runners_data.name: Starborn Legend
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner for in-form O'Brien stable, expensive purchase with smart half-brother form
runners_data.spotlight: E29,000 Y, E330,000 Breeze Up purchase; 12th foal; brother to Italian 5f/6f winner Scalea, half-brother to four winners inc String Theory (1m-9.4f AW; RPR 106) and I Could Do Better (6.7f-1m3f inc 2yo/Australia; 96); dam unraced half-sister to two Group 1 winners.

runners_data.name: Aestus Astevias
runners_data.note: Hold-up style, half-sister to high-rated sprinter Jakajaro but trainer has modest recent record
runners_data.spotlight: Sixth foal; half-sister to winners Jakajaro (Listed-placed 5f/6f inc 2yo/AW; RPR 109) and Stand Strong (2m AW; 80); unraced dam closely related to UAE Derby winner Khawlah (dam of Derby winner Masar), half-sister to 1m2f Group 2 winner Vancouverite

runners_data.name: Finika
runners_data.note: Another debutant from struggling Feane stable, related to multiple winners including 100+ rated performers
runners_data.spotlight: Tenth foal; half-sister to winners Kodiak West (Spanish/US 1m/1m1f; RPR 103), Fregada (6f 2yo; 97), Rayat (6f/8.6f inc AW; 91) and Angel Grey (6f 2yo; 83); dam German 1m winner, out of 6f/7f winning half-sister to 6f 2yo Group 2 winner Carrizo Creek.

runners_data.name: Lady Moon
runners_data.note: Unraced hold-up type with stamina pedigree, Oliver stable has couple of recent winners from small string
runners_data.spotlight: E24,000 Y; fifth foal; half-sister to winners Imperial Sands (1m AW; RPR 106) and The Falling Man (Italian 7f/7.5f AW inc 2yo); dam well held 9.5f in France only start, half-sister to 1m3f-1m5f winner Heart Of Soul.

runners_data.name: Tide Of Fortune
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who showed promise on debut but fades in finishes, 45 days since last run
runners_data.comment: Eighth foal, half-brother to winners, best of whom Silverkode achieved a 104 RPR
runners_data.spotlight: Plenty of merit in a debut run that saw him finish eighth of 24 at this venue; left an impression that he can improve.

runners_data.name: Trek Home
runners_data.note: Hold-up style improving after debut fourth, Foley booking suggests stable confidence building
runners_data.comment: Nando Parrado colt, dam Listed placed 7f winner, yard can ready one, check market
runners_data.spotlight: Likely to be capable of building on last month's debut fourth in a 5f maiden at Navan

runners_data.name: Kula Bula Boyo
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner with cheekpieces fitted, faded last time but gets sustainable pace here
runners_data.comment: Debutant likely all the better for the experience
runners_data.spotlight: Faded after a prominent run in a 7f maiden at Cork; needs to find considerable improvement; cheekpieces fitted.

runners_data.name: Frosted Sky
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who was slowly away on debut, trainer struggling and can be dismissed
runners_data.comment: No Nay Never filly; dam Listed-placed 6f winner (RPR 98); trainer can ready them
runners_data.spotlight: Slowly away and never in contention first time out at Dundalk; can be ruled out.

runners_data.name: Sancerre Rock
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with two runs under belt, trainer rides his own horses suggesting confidence
runners_data.spotlight: Made late headway when sixth of 10 at Limerick on debut; beaten further at Gowran; will need to qualify for a handicap mark.

runners_data.name: Little Roy
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who showed inexperience on debut, apprentice jockey suggests modest expectations
runners_data.comment: Newcomer likely best watched.
runners_data.spotlight: Betrayed inexperience first time at Sligo; can be left out of calculations.

runners_data.name: Contrary To Law
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with hood fitted, showed early promise but 80 days since last outing
runners_data.comment: Well-bred sort; okay run at 100-1 on debut; too keen at Galway; worth a market check
runners_data.spotlight: Ran twice at two; not disgraced at 100-1 when ninth of 15 over 7f at this venue; too keen at Galway when fourth of eight behind  Constitution River; looked a possible future winner when keeping fourth in a 16-runner 6f maiden here in March on seasonal/ stable debut.

runners_data.name: Highwayman
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who was slowly away on debut, O'Brien second string unlikely to trouble leaders
runners_data.comment: Newcomer yard second-choice, worth a look for future reference
runners_data.spotlight: Slowly away and never in contention on debut at Cork; likely to need more experience.

runners_data.name: Niobite
runners_data.note: Hold-up type taking big trip drop with tongue-tie, finished tailed off over much longer distance
runners_data.comment: Brother to 7.3f 2yo winner Wholetthedogsout; debutant likely best watched
runners_data.spotlight: Always at the back on debut over 1m2f here, takes a big drop in trip with a tongue-tie on.

runners_data.name: Quinta Girl
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning after 229 days, showed best form as juvenile but question marks remain
runners_data.spotlight: Best effort at two when a close fourth in a 6f Naas maiden; flopped in a Dundalk nursery, leaving her with a question to answer on reappearance.

runners_data.name: Pick A Window
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with no worthwhile form shown, veteran four-year-old faces tough task
runners_data.comment: No sign of worthwhile form in three outings last season, two of them at this venue
runners_data.spotlight: No sign of worthwhile form in three outings last season, struggled again at Cork on return.

races.paceDynamic: Kula Bula Boyo will take the field along at a sustainable gallop with no other confirmed front-runners in this 18-runner maiden. The Piper's Call may track from prominent while the majority including Trek Home, Tide Of Fortune, Sancerre Rock and Quinta Girl will sit in behind. With such a large field and gentle early pace, this sets up perfectly for hold-up horses to deliver late challenges down the outside. The lack of early pace pressure strongly favours closers who can unleash finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate as expected with only Kula Bula Boyo leading
scenarios.body: The field will bunch up turning for home allowing fresh closers to sweep past tired leaders. Trek Home, Tide Of Fortune and the newcomers with stamina pedigrees can time their runs perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent trackers prevail
scenarios.trigger: If The Piper's Call and other forward types press Kula Bula Boyo harder than anticipated
scenarios.body: A stronger gallop will stretch the field and favour horses positioned handily rather than too far back. The Piper's Call can use his class advantage while Sancerre Rock benefits from forward placement.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomer shock
scenarios.trigger: If one of the well-bred debutants shows unexpected early speed to track the leader
scenarios.body: The race becomes a straight battle between experience and raw ability in the final furlong. Starborn Legend or Ask Me Again could capitalise on their superior breeding telling late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front-runner stays
scenarios.trigger: If Kula Bula Boyo improves dramatically with cheekpieces and steals a march
scenarios.body: The confirmed leader gets an uncontested lead and holds on as the field struggles to close the gap. His recent prominent running at Cork suggests the ability might be there with headgear help.

watchPoints.text: The Piper's Call could be vulnerable after 333-day absence despite his class advantage over this field
Several well-bred newcomers from Feane stable running despite trainer's poor recent strike-rate suggesting market moves needed
Kula Bula Boyo gets uncontested lead which could prove decisive if cheekpieces sharpen him up significantly
Large field of 18 may cause traffic problems for hold-up horses despite the tactical advantage
Joseph O'Brien saddles Starborn Legend as expensive purchase making debut for stable in excellent current form

races.name: Sky Bet Club Irish EBF Maiden

runners_data.name: Aix La Chapelle
runners_data.spotlight: Seventh foal; Justify colt is a brother to Statuette, who won a 6f Group 2 race here as a juvenile on her second and final start, closely related to Group 1 winner Tenebrism, half-brother to Classic winner Henri Matisse, and two other winners; dam a dual Group 1 winner; superb pedigree, Ryan Moore on Giant Sequoia.

runners_data.name: Breath Of Paradise
runners_data.spotlight: E120,000 Breeze Up purchase; Blackbeard colt is the first foal out of a mare who ran only twice; solid American pedigree.

runners_data.name: Giant Sequoia
runners_data.spotlight: Third foal; by Frankel out of a Listed-winning daughter of Camelot; dam is a sister to Irish Derby winner Latrobe, half-sister to Group 3 winner Diamond Fields; Ryan Moore aboard for debut with Wayne Lordan on Aix La Chapelle.

runners_data.name: Peckedbytheparrott
runners_data.spotlight: E40,000 yearling; fourth foal; half-brother to 7f 2yo winner Solomon Islands; unraced dam out of a 1m2f Listed winner.

runners_data.name: To Infinity
runners_data.spotlight: 360,000gns yearling; fifth foal; half-brother to the useful Make Me King (four wins in stakes races) and juvenile scorer Nardra; dam a Listed winner by Rock Of Gibraltar, and a half-sister to Prix Morny winner The Wow Signal.

runners_data.name: Selwyn
runners_data.comment: Sioux Nation colt, related to 2yo winner, respected source, market can guide on debut
runners_data.spotlight: Finished 1 1/2l behind Bull Shark when fourth at Naas on debut; may improve enough to reverse form with that rival who was having his third start.

runners_data.name: Bull Shark
runners_data.spotlight: Third all three starts, the first two at this venue, over 5f on heavy and 6f on soft; beaten almost 8l behind the subsequent Marble Hill winner Great Barrier Reef on the second occasion; beaten almost as far behind the smart-looking Confucius at Naas last time; his experience should be an asset but he needs to raise his game to win a maiden.

runners_data.name: Captain James Cook
runners_data.spotlight: 190,000gns foal, 500,000gns yearling; fifth foal; half-brother to Group 1-winning sprinter Arizona Blaze, and two other winners; dam, by top-class sprinter Equiano, was a 1m2f AW winner at a modest level.

runners_data.name: Celeron
runners_data.comment: Debutant Mohaather colt likely all the better for the experience
runners_data.spotlight: 20,000gns yearling; third foal; closely related to a winner in France and Greece; dam an Italian 6f Listed winner, half-sister to an Italian Group-placed winner; relatively cheap purchase, has a decent sprinting pedigree and is in good hands.

runners_data.name: La Tache
runners_data.spotlight: 140,000gns yearling; fifth foal; brother to 5f AW winner Lady Nunthorpe, half-brother to two winners, notably Group-placed Walbank; dam 5f 2yo winner, half-sister to 1m 2yo Group 1 winner Albigna (Prix Marcel Boussac for Jessica Harrington).

runners_data.name: One Number
runners_data.spotlight: $55,000 yearling, $140,000 2yo; third foal; half-brother to US 6.5f/1m dirt winner Penei; unraced dam out of US 1m/1m1f winner; interesting newcomer for in-form top stable.

runners_data.name: Orchestrating
runners_data.spotlight: Ninth foal; half-brother to six winners including Group 3 scorer Efaadah and Alrahma; dam a Listed winner by Oasis Dream; blinkers declared for debut; Ryan Moore on Captain James Cook.

runners_data.name: Tennesspeed
runners_data.spotlight: $85,000 yearling, 200,000gns Craven Breeze Up purchase; fourth foal; half-brother to a pair of US dirt winners; dam unraced half-sister to useful US sprint winner; noteworthy but might not be suited by any significant ease in the ground.

runners_data.name: Dropping Dimes
runners_data.spotlight: Eighth foal; half-sister to three minor winners, dam 1m5f AW winner; stable not known for juvenile winners.

runners_data.name: Gwen
runners_data.spotlight: E12,000 yearling; sixth foal; half-sister to Flat/hurdle winner Dumb Love; dam 1m AW winner; faces a tough task here first time out.

runners_data.name: Little Miss Muffet
runners_data.spotlight: Third foal; dam 7f 2yo winner (inc Listed; RPR 113), sister to useful middle-distance winner Wisconsin, half-sister to winners Willow (Listed) and Sir John Hawkins, out of Irish Oaks/Yorkshire Oaks winner Peeping Fawn; may need further than this.

runners_data.name: Thatsanotherstory
runners_data.spotlight: £17,000 Y; third foal; half-sister to half-sister to two winners; dam won over 5f at two, may need experience.

runners_data.name: Sirocco Sands
runners_data.comment: E65,000 Persian Force colt, dam French 10.7f winner, market can guide on debut
runners_data.spotlight: Stayed on for second in a 5f maiden at Cork, looks best of the four who have run; probably vulnerable here with a few interesting newcomers in the line-up.

runners_data.name: Tradewinds
runners_data.comment: Wootton Bassett colt; quite speedily-bred debutant, could be ready for an immediate impact
runners_data.spotlight: Soundly beaten fifth on debut at Navan; the runner-up The Scallionator won well at Listowel on Sunday, but this one left an impression that he may need further than this.

runners_data.name: Winnie's Wish
runners_data.comment: Debutant respected from a yard with a decent recent 2yo winner
runners_data.spotlight: 20-1 when last of eight behind the promising Sergei Diaghilev over C&D on debut; unlikely to feature.

runners_data.name: Nation Blaze
runners_data.spotlight: 10-1 on debut in a 5f maiden at Cork a month ago; never showed and finished ninth of ten; safe to rule out.

races.name: Sky Bet Price Boosts Premier Handicap

runners_data.name: Cool Azul
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent form who should get ideal position tracking the leader
runners_data.comment: Second of 24 at the Curragh and no match for promising newcomer when second at Cork
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced gelding posted good second on debut in 6f maiden here in April (soft), not quite as good but solid runs both starts since, hanging left at Cork and plenty of speed dropped to 5f at Dundalk last week when third in ordinary maiden; respected on handicap debut, rain would suit.

runners_data.name: Ipanema Queen
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner but 31-day break raises fitness concerns despite Listed-class ability
runners_data.spotlight: Won 6f maiden here last year but seemed better suited to 5f as the season progressed, winning Listed races here and at Dundalk; below best when favourite both starts this year, beaten a nose by a stablemate at Dundalk (6f) and dropped out tamely in Cork fillies Listed last month on soft; return to conventional 5f to suit though may not want too much rain on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Real Encounter
runners_data.note: Prominent type in good form whose 5f Dundalk win suggests this trip suits perfectly
runners_data.comment: Only sixth of 14 on handicap debut at Naas but she won her maiden over C&D
runners_data.spotlight: Narrowly beaten by Allsortz in Dundalk maiden in April before winning over 5f there 13 days later; definite merit in handicap debut at Naas last month, close up until reportedly hitting a ridge over a furlong down before rallying; could be given another chance.

runners_data.name: Amiata
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who needs pace to aim at but has proven 5f handicap form including beating Bad Boy Rizz
runners_data.comment: Raised 7lb for 6f win at Naas latest; drops in trip, handles soft, yard in form; chance
runners_data.spotlight: 5f Navan maiden winner and gained first handicap win at Naas in April (6f, good), beating Bad Boy Rizz 1.5l; solid Cork effort off 7lb higher when fourth to all-the-way winner Allsortz over this trip (soft); considered.

runners_data.name: Allsortz
runners_data.note: Progressive front-running type who can track Ipanema Queen and has winning form at this distance
runners_data.comment: Close third behind Amiata and Bad Boy Rizz latest, same mark, forecast rain a worry
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive front-runner won Dundalk maiden, then finished third on handicap debut behind Amiata (6f, Naas) before reversing form with that rival back at today's trip at Cork last month, seeing it out well on soft; 5lb worse off with Amiata but every chance of confirming form and won't mind rain.

runners_data.name: Bad Boy Rizz
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with good recent placings who needs a strongly-run race to be effective
runners_data.comment: 6lb swing with Amiata for 1.5l defeat on latest, strip fitter now, soft fine, big chance
runners_data.spotlight: Navan 2yo maiden winner has returned with two good runs in handicaps, chasing home Amiata at Naas (6f, good) and never quite on terms third to front-running Allsortz at Cork (soft); stiffer 5f should suit.

runners_data.name: Tornado Kiss
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but poor recent AW form and stalls issues create doubt about reliability
runners_data.comment: C&D maiden winner, no joy in listed company last twice, could go well on h'cap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Beat Bad Boy Rizz in Cork 2yo maiden but twice safely held in Listed company, most recently didn't give his true running (upset in stalls) when never sighted behind Allsortz on handicap debut at Cork (soft); bit to prove now.

runners_data.name: Focaccia
runners_data.note: Prominent type improving on each run but 7lb claimer suggests connections expect tough task
runners_data.comment: Third in 6f Curragh maiden in March; has flashed tail both starts
runners_data.spotlight: Promising debut third in 6f maiden here in March; out of depth in Listed class next time, recent AW second (Cool Azul third) was her best effort yet; tailflasher; cheekpieces now tried on handicap debut (3lb wrong).

runners_data.name: Shadow Run
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 60-day break with question marks over effectiveness on good-to-soft
runners_data.spotlight: Definite step in the right direction on seasonal return at Naas in March when beaten a neck (every chance) on soft but didn't get home on similar ground in Cork rated event following month; blinkers replaced by visor here; 4lb wrong.

runners_data.name: Fox In Flight
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose Dundalk 5f win was on standard surface, may not handle this going
runners_data.comment: 5f Dundalk maiden winner, off since December, handicap debut, McAteer deserts
runners_data.spotlight: Dundalk maiden win came at this trip over the winter, later third to Sovereign Cry in conditions event at same track; soft ground may not have suited on last month's return when last of eight behind stablemate Allsortz on handicap debut at Cork; hard to see him reversing Cork form with several of these.

runners_data.name: Sovereign Cry
runners_data.note: Prominent type but turf form disappointing and 7lb claimer booking suggests limited expectations
runners_data.comment: Won here last season but the glaring concern is his recent heavy defeat at Naas
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive profile on the AW last season but too keen when soundly beaten on turf/seasonal debut at Naas last month; better back at Dundalk since but doubts remain back on turf, especially if ground eases.

runners_data.name: Sparky Sparky
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose best form is on softer ground but lacks consistency this season
runners_data.comment: Has only run on soft turf; first two runs were fine; 10-11 fav  when bombed out at Cork
runners_data.spotlight: Standout run on seasonal return when saying on third behind a smart type in Cork maiden (5f, soft) in April; ran no sort of race there last month before just fair fourth on Dundalk AW last week (3l off Cool Azul) when tried in a tongue-tie; nicely-weighted on best form and rider's claim a bonus on handicap debut.

races.paceDynamic: Ipanema Queen is the only confirmed front-runner and should dictate terms from the gates, with prominent runners Cool Azul, Real Encounter, Allsortz and Tornado Kiss tracking behind but unlikely to apply serious early pressure. The pace should be steady rather than fierce over this minimum trip, allowing the leader to control fractions before the field quickens from the 2f pole. With just one natural pacesetter and several hold-up horses needing cover, this race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can sit handy and kick, rather than closers who may find insufficient pace to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Ipanema Queen gets soft sectionals and isn't pressed early
scenarios.body: The favourite controls the tempo and has enough left to resist late challenges, while prominent trackers get first run but can't quite reel her in. This measured pace suits horses with tactical speed who can dictate.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is steady but one of the handy runners gets perfect positioning
scenarios.body: A prominent runner gets the ideal trip tracking the leader before quickening decisively in the final furlong, exploiting Ipanema Queen's 31-day break. The controlled early pace allows tactical types to finish strongest.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Powers Home
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes modest and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of pressure up front sets up a genuine sprint where closers with the best turn of foot can unleash late runs. Amiata and Bad Boy Rizz benefit from the strongly-run finish this creates.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Ipanema Queen goes too slow and gets swamped by superior handicappers
scenarios.body: The front-runner's lack of recent racing shows as she sets crawling fractions, allowing multiple horses to swoop late in a blanket finish. Class rather than position determines the outcome.

watchPoints.text: Ipanema Queen's jumping and early position - if she misses the break, the entire pace scenario changes
Bad Boy Rizz and Amiata settling in rear - they need the pace to develop into a sprint to be competitive
Cool Azul's positioning in the first furlong - his recent prominent runs suggest he wants to be handy early
Real Encounter's finishing kick - his Dundalk 5f win suggests he has the tactical speed for this scenario
Allsortz tracking the leader - his front-running style means he needs to avoid getting caught wide or in a speed duel

races.name: Sky Bet Race To The Ebor Handicap

runners_data.name: Holy See
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 55-day break, useful form on similar going with Jamie Orr's 7lb claim valuable
runners_data.comment: French AW wins over shorter; handles ground, trip an unknown on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Useful AW winner in France over 1m/1m1f; campaigned mainly over hurdles by current yard, winning Limerick novice on heavy over Christmas; fine first effort on the Flat for current yard when winning 1m4f Gowran handicap under today's rider in April (soft) under a positive ride; 5lb higher here but remains of interest.

runners_data.name: Tyson Fury
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 82-day layoff, proven stayer but needs this after mixed hurdles campaign
runners_data.spotlight: Wins have been at up to 2m (AW), winning claimer at Dundalk in March too; runner-up in ordinary maiden hurdles the last twice; can't be ruled out back on the Flat.

runners_data.name: Yulia
runners_data.note: Prominent type stepping up in distance, good form in France on soft ground but new to this track
runners_data.comment: French import who stays considerably further than this, no luck in running on Irish debut
runners_data.spotlight: Two wins in France (on soft and AW); has won over 1m7f, and had never raced at under 1m4f until recent Irish debut at Sligo; unplaced favourite after starting slowly and meeting trouble in running (1m2f); returns to a more suitable trip.

runners_data.name: Poetic Sound
runners_data.note: Prominent racer in good form over middle distances, Colin Keane booking suggests strong chance
runners_data.comment: Lightly raced 5yo goes well fresh and top-weight respected
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice over 1m4f in 2024 and began last season in form of his life over 1m6f at Navan, touched off in handicap and fine third in Listed contest; last month's 1m4f Leopardstown comeback run was encouraging, could well improve enough from that to play a major role here back at 1m6f.

runners_data.name: Emit
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with Ryan Moore, highest-rated runner returning from just 11 days, key pace angle
runners_data.spotlight: Consistent last season, going close in 1m2f Group 3 Gallinule Stakes here and later in year twice runner-up in Longchamp Group contests over 1m7f; first two runs this term at 1m6f were creditable, drop back 1m4f didn't suit latest; drops to handicap company and back to ideal trip.

runners_data.name: Too Bossy For Us
runners_data.note: Prominent type but concerning 248-day absence, versatile performer when fit but fitness query
runners_data.comment: Useful on Flat, struggled up in class since C&D maiden win, overlooked by Townend
runners_data.spotlight: Useful on the Flat, although sole win came back in 2024, narrowly beaten here over 2m last summer; equally talented hurdler, but some stiff tasks of late; market likely informative back on the Flat.

runners_data.name: Factual Fact
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in good current form, recent Killarney winner who handles the going well
runners_data.comment: Bumper winner who was closing on the winner in a 1m4f handicap at the Curragh in March
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper winner has done well since returning to the Flat, second here over 1m4f and handled better ground to win 2m1f Killarney amateur handicap last month under a positive ride; 4lb higher but could have more to offer off this low weight upped in grade.

runners_data.name: Granite Bay
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 55-day break, consistent last season and good recent Gowran effort
runners_data.comment: Three wins in 2024 and placed multiple times last term; made a decent comeback at Gowran
runners_data.spotlight: Showed good form in 2024 with a trio of wins from 1m2f-1m6f and runner-up in three of last four starts last term; plenty to take from seasonal return at Gowran in April when fourth to Holy See (1m4f, soft), rallying again late on; one to consider.

runners_data.name: Dawn Rising
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong staying form, 9-year-old veteran with class but age concern
runners_data.comment: Group 2 course winner at 2m, fine second in last year's Cesarewitch, inadequate trip here
runners_data.spotlight: No wins last season but strong form in defeat in big staying handicaps; fourth in the amateur handicap at Galway, fifth in the Irish Cesarewitch and signed off with a fine second in the Cesarewitch; recent run here was over an inadequate trip, more expected of here and seemingly McMonagle's pick.

runners_data.name: Tribal Star
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse mostly seen on AW, good turf effort last time but may need further than this trip
runners_data.spotlight: Seen mostly on AW, including fourth of 20 in the Northumberland Plate at Newcastle (2m) last June; running well on AW this year and good effort back on turf at Chester last month, only fading late on over 2m3f; upped in grade here and could go well with rider's claim.

runners_data.name: En Or
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 227-day break, long losing run and fitness major concern
runners_data.spotlight: Six-time Flat winner but losing run goes back to December 2024; hurdling last winter without success, may need this comeback run.

runners_data.name: Perry Mason
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who won here last month making all, in-form and proven track specialist
runners_data.comment: Has shown a liking for this track, suited by soft ground, would benefit from any easing
runners_data.spotlight: Was recording a third win at this track when scoring over 1m2f last month (good), making virtually all and just holding on; previously ran well over 1m4f, this his first attempt at this longer trip.

races.paceDynamic: Emit looks the natural front-runner with Ryan Moore aboard, likely to set a sustainable gallop from the outset with his prominent racing style. Perry Mason showed he can make the running when winning over 1m2f here last month, while Holy See, Yulia, Poetic Sound and Granite Bay will all race prominently behind the leaders. The large field of hold-up horses including Dawn Rising, Tyson Fury, Factual Fact, Tribal Star and En Or suggests the pace will be genuine but not frantic. This race shape strongly favors prominent racers who can position close to the pace without expending excessive energy, as they'll avoid the traffic problems that could compromise the hold-up brigade in a 12-runner field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Positioning Pays
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuine but not extreme and the prominent horses avoid early pressure
scenarios.body: Emit and Perry Mason can dictate terms from the front while Holy See, Yulia and Granite Bay travel smoothly in the slipstream. The hold-up horses will find too much traffic and ground to make up over this stamina-testing trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes unsustainably fast with Emit and Perry Mason going too hard
scenarios.body: The prominent runners will tie up in the final furlong, allowing the patient hold-up horses to sweep through. Dawn Rising and Tyson Fury have the class to capitalize if the race unfolds this way.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midfield Mover Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the race develops into a steadily-run affair with tactical positioning crucial
scenarios.body: Horses that can improve from midfield without being too far back will have the perfect position to strike. Granite Bay and Poetic Sound can position ideally to pounce when the pace quickens.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Emit fails to go forward or gets headed early, creating a muddling gallop
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class and finishing kick matter most. This would suit the higher-rated horses regardless of running style, particularly those with tactical speed.

watchPoints.text: Emit could set the race up perfectly for others if Ryan Moore allows him to go too fast early given his front-running style
Dawn Rising and Tyson Fury both returning from long breaks which could blunt their finishing kicks in a competitive handicap
Perry Mason's ability to repeat his front-running tactics from last month's win here will be crucial to his chances
The large contingent of hold-up horses could create a cavalry charge if they all get clear runs in the straight
Holy See and Granite Bay both returning from 55-day breaks need to show their fitness translates immediately

runners_data.name: Possum
runners_data.spotlight: Australia half-sister to 10.6f AW/1m4f turf winner Elsa's Pride (RPR 67); dam 9.4f AW/1m4f turf winner (96), closely related to useful 1m4f/1m6f winner Flaming Marvel; another newcomer for whom market likely best guide.

runners_data.name: Solas Na Gealai

runners_data.name: I Hope You Dance

runners_data.name: Miss Ivor

runners_data.spotlight: Modest level of form over 6f/7f; dramatic jump in trip here with cheekpieces tried.

runners_data.name: Salah Belle

runners_data.spotlight: Won over slightly further here two years ago but not since and back from a break after AW winter campaign; tongue-tie tried.

runners_data.name: Carrigans Grove

runners_data.spotlight: Enjoyed a successful 2025, winning three times, including over C&D; both runs this term have been here, more encouraging effort latest when not quite staying 7f trip; just 2lb above winning C&D mark last summer.

runners_data.name: Sommelier

runners_data.spotlight: Dual AW winner is 0-5 on turf for current trainer this year, not beaten too far on penultimate; handicapper giving him every chance and new headgear combination tried.

runners_data.name: Poweracclaim

runners_data.name: Dynamic Force

runners_data.spotlight: Speedy in his early days, winning three times over 5f for Robert Cowell; best recent form has been in 7f Down Royal handicaps, latest last Friday when strong-finishing fourth, having been keen; not sure drop back to 6f will suit.

runners_data.name: Rappell
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse wearing blinkers but recent form well below previous C&D winning standard
runners_data.comment: Turf win in 2024; needs to step up considerably on the form of this season's four outings
runners_data.spotlight: Three turf wins, the latest over C&D in 2024 off 66; recent form well below his best however so needs to bounce back.

runners_data.name: Irish Rumour
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong jockey booking but was far too keen on seasonal return 16 days ago
runners_data.comment: Only one win from 28 starts, went very close at Fairyhouse last autumn, top rider booked
runners_data.spotlight: Only one win from 29 starts; went close on occasions last year (5f-7f), far too keen on seasonal return at Roscommon last month; champion jockey stays loyal so more expected of.

runners_data.name: Hugo's Girl
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid recent C&D third but needs significant improvement as 15-race maiden
runners_data.comment: 14-race maiden has shown winning potential from time to time, others have stronger claims
runners_data.spotlight: 15-race maiden has run some solid races in defeat, notably last month over C&D when staying on third of 20 after a slow start (good); on a fair mark, could go well given a level break.

runners_data.name: Shamanka
runners_data.note: Prominent runner making turf debut with tongue-tie after AW campaign for new yard

runners_data.name: Eichan San

runners_data.spotlight: Now 0-9 but has ability judged on his keeping-on fourth of 21 over C&D in April (soft); didn't get a clear run at Down Royal on Friday so remains of interest.

runners_data.name: Kitty Bear

runners_data.name: Rosato
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with three 6f wins who should improve from recent C&D comeback after 45-day break
runners_data.spotlight: Three 6f wins came at Navan (twice) and last summer at Naas off 1lb higher; entitled to come on from C&D comeback run in April.

runners_data.name: Dandy Land
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making handicap debut after 215-day break and may need this experience
runners_data.spotlight: Couple of hard-luck stories from three maiden runs last October; potential improver entering handicaps, but may need this.

runners_data.name: Hot To Foxtrot
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with new cheekpieces making turf return but needs significant improvement
runners_data.comment: Competitive in 7f/6f handicaps on the AW this season and she has form on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden competitive in 7f/6f handicaps on the AW this season but needs to find more on turf return; cheekpieces replace tongue-tie.

runners_data.name: Ukiyo
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with good recent form including C&D second just 3 days ago with tongue-tie retained

runners_data.spotlight: Won over 6f at Cork for Gavin Cromwell last year off 50 and couple of good runs this year, runner-up at Navan in March (6f, heavy) and most recently in first-time tongue-tie on quicker ground at Listowel on Sunday when staying on to chase home a clear-cut winner over 7f (good); one to consider.

runners_data.name: Gegenpressing

runners_data.spotlight: Unbeaten in four runs at Sligo, most recently last month (third has won since) at 6.5f; 4lb rise okay but record at this track relatively underwhelming so needs to improve that.

runners_data.name: Angel Of Promise
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with fading tendencies and poor recent form despite top jockey booking
runners_data.spotlight: Handicap debut over C&D in April was poor; Keane booked now, so maybe not the forlorn hope she seems.

runners_data.name: Green Icon
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with terrible current form and fading tendencies making winning unlikely

runners_data.name: Jazzit

runners_data.comment: Maiden, 0-2 on turf, shaped like this sharper test might suit at Navan latest, considered

runners_data.name: Lady Mary Heath
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse better over further distances and may struggle dropping back to 6½f
runners_data.spotlight: Couple of good runs here this term over further, most recently no luck in running when staying on third of 17 over 7f in April from a similar draw; not sure drop in trip will be in her favour.

runners_data.name: Prime Sign
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 203-day absence with new cheekpieces after C&D win off this mark
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly-raced mare won over C&D over a year ago off this mark (good); absent since okay AW run in November  with cheekpieces tried.

races.paceDynamic: Sommelier is the only confirmed early leader and should get an uncontested lead with Four Blondes, Salah Belle, Carrigans Grove, Dynamic Force, Irish Rumour and Shamanka sitting prominent but none willing to challenge for the early pace. This creates a sustained tempo without early pressure, allowing the pace-setters to dictate through halfway before the large hold-up brigade including Jon Riggens, Hugo's Girl, Kitty Bear, Rosato and Eichan San starts their challenge in the final 2f. With 23 runners and minimal early pace pressure, this race strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and kick from 2f out, as the hold-up horses will face traffic problems and the leader may fade late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates traffic problems for hold-up horses and Sommelier sets steady fractions
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run at the leader and avoid the scrimmaging behind, with Four Blondes and Carrigans Grove perfectly positioned to strike. Hold-up horses get caught in traffic or arrive too late against the sustained pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Overcomes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong and Sommelier's known stamina limitations kick in
scenarios.body: The patient tactics pay off as the early speed collapses, allowing Hugo's Girl and Kitty Bear to weave through and finish strongest. Jon Riggens uses his course experience to find a gap late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sommelier Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If no horse challenges Sommelier early and he gets easy fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader builds a decisive advantage and his new headgear combination helps him see out the trip better than recent form suggests. The hold-up horses leave their runs too late to catch him.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the favorites get caught up in traffic or fail to handle the going conditions
scenarios.body: Ukiyo continues his recent good form with tactical pace positioning, or Gegenpressing transfers his Sligo form to the Curragh. The race becomes messy and suits an improving outsider.

watchPoints.text: Sommelier may get uncontested lead and prove hard to peg back if new headgear helps stamina
Traffic problems likely in home straight with 23 runners creating chaos for hold-up horses
Four Blondes and Carrigans Grove both drawn to track the pace without early interference
Jon Riggens needs significant luck in running to utilize his strong course record effectively
Kitty Bear's winning streak and rider combination makes her dangerous if getting clear run late
